text: The future of AI is a popular topic today. Most experts agree that artificial general intelligence (AGI) is the next big step. Unlike today's narrow AI, AGI would think and learn like a human. This could bring huge benefits, such as better healthcare, smarter education, and solutions to climate change. However, there are also serious risks. AGI could take jobs, spread false information, or even be dangerous if we lose control of it. Timeline predictions vary widely: some experts believe AGI may arrive within twenty years, while others think it is much further away. One thing is clear: we need careful rules and global cooperation to make sure AI benefits everyone.
